name: Soniox TTS Real-Time v2
access: Soniox TTS WebSocket API (real-time, several streams per connection) and REST API, model tts-rt-v2
Regions: US, EU, JP and IN
Python, Node.js, Web and React SDKs

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with bracketed audio tags and written emphasis
voice.output_audio: Raw pcm_f32le, pcm_s16le, pcm_mulaw and pcm_alaw, wav, flac, mp3, opus and aac; sample rates 8 to 48 kHz depending on the format, 24 kHz by default; MP3 and AAC bitrates 32 to 320 kbps [so-formats]
voice.voices: studio-quality built-in voices that each speak every language, and voice cloning from a reference clip of up to 2 minutes made in the console or through the API [so-voices] [so-clone]
languages: 60+ languages from one model, every voice in every language; the docs list the ISO codes and some script limits (Serbian and Bosnian in Latin script only, Kazakh in Cyrillic only, Chinese in Simplified only) [so-langs]
voice.session_limit: Each real-time stream and each REST response is capped at 2 minutes of generated audio (fixed); defaults of 3 concurrent streams or requests, 100 requests a minute and 5 streams per connection (the last is fixed) [so-limits-rt] [so-limits-rest]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Billed in tokens, not characters or per Mtok of text. Input text tokens US$4.00 per 1M and output audio tokens US$21.50 per 1M. The maker's page gives about 0.3 input text tokens per character and about 30,000 output audio tokens per hour of speech, which is about US$0.70 per hour of generated speech [so-pricing]. Artificial Analysis lists US$14.23 per 1M characters [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, read on 2026-10-04

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model
max_output: not published in tokens; the limit is 2 minutes of generated audio per stream
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (token pricing for text in and audio out), see notes
system_card: Soniox publishes no system card or model card for TTS in the pages read
voice.turn_detection: not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: not applicable; a synthesis model does not take turns
voice.latency: Soniox says generation starts from the first few words and gives no figure in the pages read [so-rt]
